Bihar DCECE Polytechnic Result 2026 - Complete Details

Bihar DCECE Polytechnic Result 2026. Candidates who appeared in the examination can now check their result and download the scorecard from the official website. The last date to apply is 21/04/2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Start Date : 19/03/2026
  • Last Date : 21/04/2026
  • Last Date Fee : 22/04/2026
  • Correction Date : 23-24 April 2026
  • Admit Card : 15/05/2026
  • Exam Date : 23-24 May 2026
  • Download Admit Card : Click Here

Application Fee

  • Start Date : 19/03/2026
  • Last Date : 21/04/2026
  • Last Date Fee : 22/04/2026
  • General / BC / EBC : Single Course Rs. 750/-Double Course Rs. 850/-🔥 People Also ViewedUP GNM Entrance Exam UPGET Result 2026DUVASU Mathura PVT Result 2026BPSC 70th Final Result 2026UP Polytechnic JEECUP 2026 Result for Entrance ExamSSC Delhi Police Constable Executive Result 2026Triple Course Rs. 950/-
  • SC / ST/ : Single Course Rs. 480/-Single Course Rs. 530/-Triple Course Rs. 630/-

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
